art_direction: 短高黑弧下压成大黑瞳，双眼微仰，白缺口长短不同，无眉短嘴。
composition: centered hand-drawn eye pair; auxiliary marks only when specified; large blank paper margins

color_randomization.method: golden-angle hue spacing with seeded single-hue saturation and lightness variation

color_treatment: one opaque flat color beside each pupil; no gradient or shaded rendering
creative_direction: Make two short high upper arcs with a loaded flat brush, then press the paint downward into broad pupils. Both gaze slightly upward. Leave a blunt white gap within each dark mass, longer in the left pupil and wider in the right. A few centimeters of lower contour are suggested by one short brush touch per eye; the corners stay open. No brows. Place a short off-level mouth below, keeping the whole group loose but contained.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
